reviews.text:
I met Davide based on the positive reviews of his work, and I must say they were fully confirmed!
First of all, he's still one of those people who believes in human relationships and prefers to get to know animals and their humans in person, listening, observing, and asking carefully to understand the situation before formulating a possible course of action and, above all, a quote. I really appreciated that. It's clear that, in addition to his expertise, Davide loves animals, cares for them with dedication, and knows how to "read" them perfectly! Unfortunately, my plans to set up a program to acclimatize my dog, adopted as an adult, were interrupted by my furry friend's health issues. However, Davide remained close to us, showing interest and providing helpful advice, so we hope to resume our journey soon!

One of the best dog-sitting experiences I've ever had: Davide is reliable, thorough, attentive to the animals' needs, and patient. My dogs had a great time, and so did I. I hope we'll soon have the opportunity to use Lo Zio Dog again!
Davide is a kind and always available person who accommodates all our needs. He's a true friend to our dog, who always feels at home with him.

Davide has been our dog trainer and dog sitter for a year. We get along very well with him and have learned so much from his lessons.
Timo is our first dog, and before him, we weren't familiar with many of the tricks and exercises we could do together. Davide supports us and teaches us how to behave appropriately, because first and foremost, we must learn good manners around our dogs.
Davide is clear and confident in his advice.
After just one observation, he understands where to intervene to improve the relationship between dog and "parent"! I recommend everyone to take a training course with him! Today, thanks to his help, we can spend more carefree time with our dog!
Thanks, Davide

I left Donnie with Davide last Friday, and I immediately knew I could relax.
When I picked him up in the afternoon, I found him calm...but also tired, a sign that he'd been active and playing with us all day. 😊 …
What I like about Davide is the way he relates to animals... he plays with them and you can see that he does it because he loves animals, for him it's not just a job, he cares and it shows...
Sensible and passionate about his work, Davide immediately inspires trust and kindness. His ability to connect with all animals is remarkable; he's extremely helpful and approachable. …
Prepared and available, he will take care of your friends.
